title: miaomiao settings
symptom: User asks if recommended settings for miaomiao are same as blucon, and reports seeing a checksum error in the status page after getting the miaomiao.
cause: Checksum error from time to time does not mean a bug; it indicates some data corruption but the checksum mechanism protects and a retry happens. It is common in NFC or other communications.
fix: Ignore the checksum error; it is not a bug and retries happen automatically. Also, ensure the miaomiao is attached well to the sensor.
evidence_quote: Checksum error from time to time does not mean a bug. It means some thought of data corruption, but the checksum mechanism protects from than and a retry happens.
